test_title: PYST 25: Selection Post (Graduation Level) - Reasoning (Held On 2 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the following numbers will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

13, 21, ?, 69, 133
solution:
The pattern followed in the given series is:

**The difference between the terms is a multiple of 2 of the previous difference.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b45f22829d8e54b07c4eba37d5f019e053fb576852d916c3c4bf8717684abfe5.png] 

Hence **the correct answer is option 2)**
